subject: Media Literacy
title: Right-Leaning Bias in Media
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Right-Leaning Bias in Media.

hook.text: Fox News launched in 1996 as 'Fair and Balanced.' Internal memos showed a deliberate conservative editorial strategy.

buildup.text: Right-leaning bias favors conservative perspectives through story selection, framing, and commentary.

discovery.text: Conservative media has grown into a powerful ecosystem — talk radio, Fox News, and digital outlets like The Daily Wire.

twist.text: Right-leaning media often frames itself as countering liberal bias — bias presented as a corrective can be even harder to spot.

climax.text: Recognizing right-leaning bias means noticing which conservative assumptions go unquestioned in certain coverage.

punchline.text: Right bias exists too. Being a 'corrective' doesn't make it neutral.

quiz.question: How does right-leaning media often frame its own bias?
options: As a corrective to liberal bias, making its own bias harder to detect
